questions.question: A # B means 'A is the father of B' A @ B means 'A is the brother of B' A & B means 'A is the son of B' If H & I @ J # K @ L, then how is J related to L?
questions.questionHtml:
A # B means 'A is the father of B'

A @ B means 'A is the brother of B'

A & B means 'A is the son of B'

If H & I @ J # K @ L, then how is J related to L?
questions.solution:
Given expression: 'H & I @ J # K @ L'

H is the son of I, I is the brother of J, J is the father of K and K is the brother of L.

​

Here, J is the father of L.

questions.question: If '+' means 'multiplication', '-' means 'division', '×' means 'subtraction' and '÷' means 'addition', then what is the value of the following expression? 26 + 342 - 19 × 73 ÷ 14
questions.questionHtml:
If '+' means 'multiplication', '-' means 'division', '×' means 'subtraction' and '÷' means 'addition', then what is the value of the following expression?

26 + 342 - 19 × 73 ÷ 14
questions.solution:
Given:

⇒ 26 + 342 - 19 × 73 ÷ 14

After changing the sign as per the table:

⇒ 26 × 342 ÷ 19 - 73 + 14

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 26 × 18 - 73 + 14

⇒ 468 - 73 + 14

⇒ 482 - 73 = 409

⇒ '26 × 342 ÷ 19 - 73 + 14 = 409'

15 ÷ 3 + 15 - 3 × 3 = 47
questions.solution:
(1) - and ×

⇒ 15 ÷ 3 + 15 - 3 × 3 = 47

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 15 ÷ 3 + 15 × 3 - 3 = 47

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 5 + 15 × 3 - 3

⇒ 5 + 4 5 - 3

⇒ 50 - 3 = 47

questions.solution: The correct answer is option 3, Gautami. Godavari is the second longest river in India after the Ganges. It originates in the Western Ghats of Maharashtra and flows through the states of Maharashtra, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh, and finally emptiesinto the Bay of Bengal.

questions.question: As per National Multidimensional Poverty Index - Baseline Report, published by NITI Aayog in 2021, what percentage of population in urban areas is poor?
questions.questionHtml: As per National Multidimensional Poverty Index - Baseline Report, published by NITI Aayog in  2021, what percentage of population in urban areas is poor?
questions.solution: National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) is an initiative by the Government of India to measure poverty in a comprehensive manner, taking into account various factors such as health, education, and living standards. The baseline report of MPI was published by NITI Aayog in 2021, and covers both rural and urban areas of the country.

questions.questionHtml: Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan awardee, Yamini Krishnamurthy is renowned for Bharatanatyam and which of the following dances?

questions.question: When did the first 5 year plan start?
questions.questionHtml: When did the first 5 year plan start?
questions.solution: The first 5-year plan started on April 1, 1951. This plan was launched by the government of India under the leadership of Jawaharlal Nehru, the first Prime Minister of India. The main aim of the plan was to develop the Indian economy and reduce poverty and unemployment.The plan focused on agriculture, irrigation, power, transport, and communication sectors.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding the Finance Commission of India? A. The Finance Commission consist of a Chairman and four other members. B. The recommendations made by the Finance Commission are binding on the government and the government needs to grant funds according to the advice of the Commission, C. Article 280 of the Indian Constitution talks about the recommendations of the Finance Commission.
questions.questionHtml:
Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding the Finance Commission of India?

A. The Finance Commission consist of a Chairman and four other members.

B. The recommendations made by the Finance Commission are binding on the government and the government needs to grant funds according to the advice of the Commission,

C. Article 280 of the Indian Constitution talks about the recommendations of the Finance Commission.
questions.solution: The correct answer is option 3 (A and C only). The Finance Commission of India is a Constitutional body established under Article 280 of the Indian Constitution. The Commission consists of a Chairman and four other members appointed by the President of India. The recommendations made by the Finance Commission are advisory in nature and not binding on the government.

questions.question: Where did Vivekananda participate at the World's Parliament of Religions?
questions.questionHtml: Where did Vivekananda participate at the World's Parliament of Religions?
questions.solution: Vivekananda participated in the World's Parliament of Religions held in Chicago in 1893.He was invited to represent Hinduism and deliver a speech on the first day of the conference. His speech, which began with the famous words "Sisters and Brothers of America", was a powerful message of universal brotherhood and the importance of tolerance and acceptance of all religions.

questions.question: The valency of argentic is :
questions.questionHtml: The valency of argentic is :
questions.solution: The valency of argentic is +2, which means it can lose two electrons to form a cation with a charge of +2. The name argentic is derived from the Latin word argentum, which means silver.

questions.question: In which year did an American cytogeneticist named Joe Hin Tjio publish a research finding that defined 2n = 46 as the exact number of human chromosomes?
questions.questionHtml: In which year did an American cytogeneticist named Joe Hin Tjio publish a research finding that defined 2n = 46 as the exact number of human chromosomes?
questions.solution: Joe Hin Tjio was an American cytogeneticist who published a research finding in the year 1956 that defined 2n = 46 as the exact number of human chromosomes. Tjio's research finding was based on his extensive experiments involving the counting of chromosomes in human cells using microscopy and other techniques. The discovery of the exact number of human chromosomes was a landmark achievement in the field of genetics and had significant implications for the study of human diseases and genetic disorders.

questions.question: In which district of Gujarat is the Modhera dance festival organised by the Government of Gujarat?
questions.questionHtml: In which district of Gujarat is the Modhera dance festival organised by the Government of Gujarat?
questions.solution: The Modhera dance festival is organized by the Government of Gujarat in the Mehsana district of Gujarat. The festival is held annually in the month of January at the Sun Temple in Modhera, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.The festival showcases various classical dance forms of India such as Kathak, Bharatnatyam, Kuchipudi, and Odissi.

questions.question: Where does the lower salinity water rest with the higher salinity dense water?
questions.questionHtml: Where does the lower salinity water rest with the higher salinity dense water?
questions.solution: The lower salinity water rests above the higher salinity dense water due to the principle of density stratification.This occurs because saltwater is denser than freshwater, and as a result, the denser saltwater sinks below the less dense freshwater. This phenomenon is important in oceanography and marine biology, as it affects the distribution of nutrients and organisms in the water column.

questions.question: Which of the following is known as 'bodybuilding food'?

questions.solution:

questions.question: A 15 cm long perpendicular is drawn from the centre of a circle to a 40 cm long chord. Find the diameter of the circle.

questions.question: If (x + \(\rm \frac{1}{x}\) ) = 3 \(\sqrt2\) , and x > 1, what is the value of (x 8 - \(\frac{1}{x^8}\) )?
questions.questionHtml: If (x + \(\rm \frac{1}{x}\)) = 3\(\sqrt2\), and x > 1, what is the value of (x8 - \(\frac{1}{x^8}\))?
questions.solution:
x + 1/x = 3√2 ⇒ (x +1/x)2 = 18 ⇒ x2 + 1/x2 + 2 = 18 ⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = 16

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2)2 = 162 ⇒ x4 + 1/x4 + 2 = 256 ⇒ x4 + 1/x4 = 254 ⇒ x4 + 1/x4 - 2 = 254 - 2

⇒ (x2 - 1/x2)2 = 252 ⇒ x2 - 1/x2 = 6√7

⇒ x8 - 1/x8 = (x4 + 1/x4)(x4 - 1/x4) = 254 × 16 × 6√7 = 24384√7

questions.question: The width of a rectangle is 2 m less than its length. If the perimeter of the rectangle is 68 m, then what is the length (in metres) of the rectangle?
questions.questionHtml: The width of a rectangle is 2 m less than its length. If the perimeter of the rectangle is 68 m, then what is the length (in metres) of the rectangle?
questions.solution:
Let the breadth be = b and length be = b + 2

68 m = 2 [(b + 2 + b)] ⇒ 68 = 2 [2b + 2] ⇒ 68 = 4b + 4 ⇒ 4b = 68 - 4 = 64 ⇒ b = 64/8 = 16 m

questions.question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 12 minutes; pipe B can fill it in 18 minutes, while pipe C can empty the full tank in 36 minutes. If all the pipes are opened simultaneously, how much time will it take to fill the empty tank completely?
questions.questionHtml: Pipe A can fill a tank in 12 minutes; pipe B can fill it in 18 minutes, while pipe C can empty the full tank in 36 minutes. If all the pipes are opened simultaneously, how much time will it take to fill the empty tank completely?
questions.solution:
Let the total capacity of the tank = 72 units [LCM of 12, 18 and 36]

Efficiency of Pipe A = 72/12 = 6

Efficiency of Pipe B = 72/18 = 4  

Efficiency of Pipe C = 72/36 = -2 (outlet pipe)  

Combined efficiency of (A + B + C) = 6 + 4 + (-2) = 8

So, Time taken by (A + B + C) to fill the tank = 72/8 = 9 minutes

questions.question: The length, breadth and height of a cuboid are in the ratio 1 ∶ 2 ∶ 3. The length, breadth and height of the cuboid are increased by 200%, 300% and 300%, respectively. Then compared to the original volume, the increase in the volume of the cuboid will be :
questions.questionHtml: The length, breadth and height of a cuboid are in the ratio 1 ∶ 2 ∶ 3. The length, breadth and height of the cuboid are increased by 200%, 300% and 300%, respectively. Then compared to the original volume, the increase in the volume of the cuboid will be :
questions.solution:
Let the Length, breadth and height of the cuboid be 100, 200, and 300 respectively.

Volume of cuboid = 100 × 200 × 300 = 6000000

Length increased by 200%, Breadth increase by 300% and height by 300%

Now, new length = 300, breadth = 800 and height = 1200 respectively

⇒ new volume of cuboid = 300 × 800 × 1200 = 288000000

Increase in volume = (288000000 – 6000000)/6000000 = 282000000/6000000 = 47 times

questions.question: A boat's speed in still water is 45 km/h, while the river is flowing at a speed of 15 km/h. The time taken to cover a certain distance upstream is 9 h more than the time taken to cover the same distance downstream. Find the distance (in km).
questions.questionHtml: A boat's speed in still water is 45 km/h, while the river is flowing at a speed of 15 km/h. The time taken to cover a certain distance upstream is 9 h more than the time taken to cover the same distance downstream. Find the distance (in km).
questions.solution:
Upstream speed = (45 - 15) = 30 km/h, Downstream speed = (45 + 15) = 60 km/h. 

Now, let the required distance be d then,

⇒ d/30 - d/60 = 9 ⇒ (2d - d)/60 = 9 ⇒ d = 9 × 60 = 540

questions.question: A dealer's cost price for each fan he would like to sell is ₹2,000. After allowing a discount of 20% on its marked price, he gains 20%. His marked price of the fan is :
questions.questionHtml: A dealer's cost price for each fan he would like to sell is ₹2,000. After allowing a discount of 20% on its marked price, he gains 20%. His marked price of the fan is :
questions.solution:
Let the M.P. be 100x

Then, S.P. = 100 - 20% of 100 ⇒ 100 - (20/100) × 100 = 80x

Now, S.P. = (2000)(100 + 20)/100

⇒ 2400 ⇒ 80x = 2400 ⇒ x = 30

⇒ M.P = 100x → 30 × 100 = 3000

questions.question: The ratio of the speed of a motorboat to that of the current of water is 31 ∶ 6. The motorboat starts from a point and covers a certain distance along the current in 4 h 10 min. Find the time taken by the motorboat to come back to its initial point.
questions.questionHtml: The ratio of the speed of a motorboat to that of the current of water is 31 ∶ 6. The motorboat starts from a point and covers a certain distance along the current in 4 h 10 min. Find the time taken by the motorboat to come back to its initial point.
questions.solution:
Speed of downstream = 31x + 6x = 37x km/h

Speed of upstream = 31x – 6x = 25x km/h  

The distance covered by the downstream = 37x × (25 /6) km 

Time is taken by upstream =  [37x × (25 /6) ]/25x =  37/ 6 = 6h + 1/ 6 = 6h 10 min.

The table also shows the number of students of these four departments in five different colleges, with the total number of students being 2080. College Students Mechanical Civil Computer Science Applied IIT Delhi 430 - 20% - 10% IIT Kanpur 350 20% - 25% - IIT Bombay - 20% 18% - 32% IIT Madras - - 25% 18% 35% IIT Guwahati 400 20% 22% - 20% If the number of students in IIT Bombay is 20% less than the number of students in IIT Madras, then what is the difference between the total number of students who study in the Applied department in these two colleges and that of the students who study in the Civil department in these two colleges?
questions.questionHtml:
Study the given table carefully and answer the following question.

The table shows the percentage of students of four departments - Mechanical, Civil, Computer Science and Applied - with each student being in only one department. The table also shows the number of students of these four departments in five different colleges, with the total number of students being 2080.

College Students Mechanical  Civil Computer Science Applied
IIT Delhi 430 - 20% - 10%
IIT Kanpur 350 20% - 25% -
IIT Bombay - 20% 18% - 32%
IIT Madras - - 25% 18% 35%
IIT Guwahati 400 20% 22% - 20%
If the number of students in IIT Bombay is 20% less than the number of students in IIT Madras, then what is the difference between the total number of students who study in the Applied department in these two colleges and that of the students who study in the Civil department in these two colleges?
questions.solution:
Let the number of students in IIT Madras be x.

Then, the number of students in IIT Bombay = x × (100 - 20)/100 = 4/5x

The number of students in IIT Bombay and in IIT Madras = 2080 - (430 + 350 + 400) = 900

⇒ x + 4/5x = 900 ⇒ 9/5x = 900 ⇒ x = 500 ⇒ 4/5x → 500 × 4/5 = 400

The total number of students who study in the Applied department in these two colleges = 400 × 32% + 500 × 35% = 128 + 175 = 303

The total number of students who study in the Civil department in these two colleges = 400 × 18% + 500 × 25% = 72 + 125 = 197

Difference ⇒ 303 - 197 = 106

Key Points

  • The word "egalitaerian" is incorrectly spelt and should be corrected to "egalitarian". (समानतावादी)
  • ​"Egalitarian" refers to the principle that all people are equal and deserve equal rights and opportunities. (समानतावादी)

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Freedams (स्वतंत्रताएं): This is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "freedoms".
    • Example: People cherish their freedoms and are willing to fight for them.
  • Developement (विकास): This is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "development".
    • Example: Development in rural areas is crucial for the overall growth of the nation.

  • The word "Meticulous" means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise. (सावधानीपूर्वक)
    • Example: She is meticulous in her work, leaving no detail unnoticed.
  • "Careless" refers to not giving sufficient attention or thought to avoiding harm or errors. (लापरवाह)
    • Example: His careless attitude often leads to mistakes.
  • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of 'Meticulous' is 'Careless'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Heedful (सावधान): Paying careful attention to something.
    • Example: He was heedful of the potential dangers in the forest.
  • Careful (सावधान): Making sure to avoid potential danger, mishap, or harm.
    • Example: She was careful not to spill any ink on the carpet.
  • Untidy (अव्यवस्थित): Not arranged neatly and in order.
    • Example: His room was untidy, with clothes strewn everywhere.
